Browser wait strategy 'fixed' waits for a specific duration after page navigation

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::scrape;
use crawlberg::CrawlConfig;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine_config: CrawlConfig = serde_json::from_str("{\"browser\":{\"extra_wait\":100,\"mode\":\"always\",\"wait\":\"fixed\"}}").expect("config should parse");
    let engine = create_engine(Some(engine_config)).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let url = r#"https://example.com"#.to_string();
    let result = scrape(&engine, &url).await;
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
